prompt:
Create ONE polished full-body FRONT VIEW of the exact same original adult woman shown in the references, now expanding the positively reviewed face into a contemporary game heroine outfit proposal. First image is the face anchor; second image supplies the frontal construction (left panel only). Preserve recognizable identity: adult 27-year-old, chestnut-red asymmetrical collarbone bob with outward flipped ends, side-swept fringe, amber almond eyes, strong tapering upper lash line, compact tiny anime nose and small fine-line confident smile, softly tapered mature jaw. Do not lengthen the nose, change the eyes, or make a different generic face.

Portrait orientation, full head to soles, plenty of margin above crown and below shoes. Character is front-facing, upright head, level shoulders, hips forward, natural relaxed standing stance, feet slightly apart with both fully visible. Hands relaxed at sides with small space separating them from torso and thighs, readable natural five-finger anatomy. Neutral pale warm-gray studio background, soft ground contact shadow, even daylight. No inset, no extra view, no text.

An unmistakably adult, gracefully voluptuous silhouette: full bust, defined waist, balanced wider hips and substantial thighs, long but believable legs, approximately seven-and-a-half heads tall. Tasteful confident mature appeal, not ultra-thin fashion-model proportions. Fully clothed with natural fabric volume.

Retain the charcoal-gray long-sleeve collared button-up shirt from the approved portrait, cream inner collar facing, open collar only at the neck/upper sternum, opaque fabric. Gently fitted and tucked into the waistband, no strained buttons or exposed midriff. Sleeves neatly rolled just below elbows. Add a high-waisted warm taupe tailored A-line skirt ending just above the knees, clean single front panel with a subtle offset seam, no pleats or decorative straps. A narrow dark-brown belt with a small brushed brass rectangular buckle. Dark brown leather ankle boots with modest block heels, both complete boots on the ground. Minimal contemporary mature styling, no jewelry, badges, hair clips or fantasy accessories.

Match the reference's fine colored facial contours, expressive detailed amber eyes, decisive hair highlights and clean cel shadows with restrained skin gradients. Preserve facial detail even at full-body scale. Keep hair and facial silhouette consistent with the face anchor. This is a new body/outfit proposal, not an outfit copied from the previous silver-haired reference. Avoid photorealism, 3D, pixel art, chibi, childlike proportions, exaggerated perspective, sexual pose, cropped feet, hidden hands, or tilted glamour pose.
feedback_scope: User relayed positive client feedback for face and front shot only. New body and outfit are pending review.
visual_review: Face, chestnut bob and amber eyes broadly consistent; full crown and both boots visible; hands visible, fingers small and overlapping. Slight head/body asymmetry remains. Skirt is fitted rather than requested A-line, shirt button area has strong tension folds. Approximate frontal proposal, not orthographic. Body, skirt, boots and sleeve roll are new proposals.
